topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Finding the time capsule was like uncovering a secret garden, hidden not by thorns or stone but by time itself. I unearthed it with a gentle curiosity, as if stirring the past from a deep slumber. Inside, the air held a breath of nostalgia, each item a puzzle piece that didn’t quite fit my memory. Yet, there they were, neatly packed: a faded photograph, a journal with crumbling pages, a cassette tape from a time when such things were whispers of the future. How curious, to stumble upon a promise I didn’t recall making. Each relic spoke of a life I’d lived yet forgotten. I felt a kinship with this stranger, a version of myself buried in the earth, waiting to be rediscovered. The capsule wasn’t just a container of forgotten items; it was a testament to the silent pulses of time, a bridge between who I was and who I am now.
